title: Sentinel Managed Security Contract Schedule: Notice Periods, Renewal Terms, Uplift Caps and Early Termination Fees
content:
Sentinel Managed Security subscriptions carry tier-specific contract figures for notice, automatic renewal, the renewal rate increase and early termination.

**Notice period.** The calendar days of signed notice required before term end for non-renewal, and the minimum notice for early termination (whole days).

**Renewal term.** The length of each automatic renewal term (months).

**Renewal uplift cap.** The maximum rate increase at renewal (percent).

**Early termination fee.** The early termination fee as a percent of committed monthly fees remaining after the effective date (percent).

| Sentinel tier | Notice period (calendar days) | Renewal term (months) | Renewal uplift cap | Early termination fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 30 | 1 | 7.0 percent | 0 percent |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 60 | 12 | 5.0 percent | 75 percent |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 60 | 12 | 5.0 percent | 75 percent |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 60 | 12 | 5.0 percent | 75 percent |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 90 | 12 | 5.0 percent | 80 percent |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 90 | 12 | 4.0 percent | 80 percent |

## Notes to the schedule

- The one notice period of each tier serves both purposes: it is the advance notice required for non-renewal and the minimum notice for early termination.
- Sentinel EDR Essentials renews month by month and carries no early termination fee; every other tier renews for 12 months.
- The uplift cap is highest on Sentinel EDR Essentials (7.0 percent) and lowest on Sentinel XDR Enterprise (4.0 percent).
